Scope: current task *.result.json through depth 2; independent runner-prep tiny receipts; root journals; requested prior checkers
Limitations: Only registered historical identities are compared; the currently executing checker is explicitly pending an independent new-process check.
Windows PID/start/argv/parent comparison cannot verify Linux descendants or CUDA disposal.
Very short intermediate processes can exit between snapshots; retained root handle facts and structured argv are preserved without inventing a native command line.
An absent PID is established by an exact bounded CIM query; a reused PID is not signalled. Same-start identity changes or missing native argv/parent are unknown and fail.
Receipt status/exit codes are preserved and do not substitute for actual identity comparison.
New receipts created after enumeration require another new-label check; this is a bounded snapshot, not a continuous monitor.
ROADMAP baseline bytes are explicitly excluded because authorized experiment document updates are handled separately.
